rationale: I re-hashed the held FR text (sha 1a7ed4c0...) and read it all: EO 11537 (35 FR 9991, signed 1970-06-16) has a single operative command, to amend Selective Service Regulations section 1631.7 by inserting a proviso on registrants who fail to report for physical examination. It is a one-time amending order with no term, expiry or savings clause. I read the held EO 12553 text (Revocation of Various Executive Orders, 1986-02-25): its opening orders that 'the following Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked', and its numbered table at p. 7241 lists '11537 Amending Selective Service regulations', with no exception, partial scope or savings section. That is an express, unqualified revocation of the whole order, so a NO is supported by the actor text, not by the 1989 'Revoked by EO 12553' row, which I treat only as a corroborating lead. Earlier endings: the amending command was performed when the amendment was made, and EO 11563 later restated section 1631.7 and cites EO 11537, so the order may have been spent or overtaken earlier, but that could only move the first end earlier and does not change a NO. The 11555, 11586 and 11606 ACT leads do not mention 11537 or section 1631.7. I assert no end date or interval. The Proc. 3989 cross-reference has no held acting text and is retained as a lifecycle lead only. The regulatory text the order inserted, and how 12553 relates to it, are a lifecycle question not decided here. The original is an OCR layer of the FR page (not page-image-verified).
